instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit'
Apply Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) using the exact color codes provided.
Do NOT use pure orange or saffron. Use the Muted Terracotta (#8C3B30) as primary CTA.
Do NOT use standard Vercel/Shadcn components without heavily overriding colors and radii to match the provided layout_spacing and colors.
Implement the Add-to-Cart hover interaction on product cards exactly as described in components_strategy > product_cards.
For the Admin dashboard, stick to the clean 'Grid Borders' style rather than excessive soft shadows.
Ensure the hero slider rotates between the 3 generated hero images provided.
Use the provided product URLs to seed the initial database or mock data.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
